ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-dominance of low-intensity pixels; estimated macro-level ratio of 3:97 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) across visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid low-intensity pigmentation covering the entire visible ventral area; singular focal high-intensity pixel cluster located at the upper-medial boundary near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward trajectory on the posterior margins, ending in acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized jagged indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, situated approximately 70% distal from the median notch.
